title: Spider-Man Foils Bank Heist Over Midtown
summary: Web-slinger stops armed robbers mid-getaway, leaving them stuck to a lamppost for police.
content: Witnesses say the masked vigilante swung into action just as the robbers fled First National Bank with several bags of cash.
Police arrived to find all four suspects webbed to a lamppost, bags intact. Commissioner's office declined to comment on the vigilante's methods.
Editor J. Jonah Jameson maintains the incident was 'staged for publicity'.

title: Oscorp Unveils Controversial Lab Expansion
summary: Residents question safety as Oscorp announces a new research wing in Queens.
content: Oscorp announced a 40,000 sq ft expansion with 'next-generation biotech' labs.
Community groups demand independent safety audits following past incidents.

title: Is Spider-Man a Hero or a Menace?
summary: Our editor weighs in on the masked wall-crawler's growing influence on the city.
content: Since his first appearance, the wall-crawler has divided New Yorkers.
Supporters point to lives saved; critics cite property damage and a lack of accountability.

title: Vulture Sighted Over Brooklyn Skyline
summary: Reports of a winged flyer prompt a no-fly advisory near the Brooklyn Bridge.
content: Multiple callers reported a metallic winged figure circling rooftops at dawn.
Spider-Man was seen in pursuit before both vanished into low cloud.

title: Daily Bugle Photographer Wins Press Award
summary: Peter Parker's rooftop shots earn the city's top photojournalism prize.
content: The freelance photographer's exclusive images of the wall-crawler in action were praised for their 'uncanny proximity'.
Parker said he's 'just in the right place at the right time'.

title: Doctor Octopus Escapes Ryker's Custody
summary: Authorities warn the public after the scientist-turned-villain breaks out overnight.
content: Prison officials confirm the breakout occurred during a power failure.
Citizens are urged to report any sightings of mechanical tentacles.

title: Midtown High Science Fair Draws Record Crowd
summary: Students showcase web-fluid inspired adhesives and clean-energy projects.
content: More than 300 entries were judged, with adhesive science a surprising favourite.
Organisers credit renewed local interest in STEM.

title: Mayor Proposes City-Wide Vigilante Registry
summary: New bill would require masked heroes to register with the NYPD.
content: The proposal has drawn support from police unions and fierce criticism from civil liberties groups.
A council vote is expected next month.

title: Queens Bakery Thanks Friendly Neighbourhood Hero
summary: A local baker credits Spider-Man with saving the shop from a runaway truck.
content: The owner baked a hundred pastries 'for whoever needs one'.
The hero left a thank-you note in webbing on the front window.

title: Sandman Spotted Near Coney Island Beach
summary: Lifeguards report unusual sand formations and a very large, very sandy man.
content: Beachgoers were evacuated for two hours as police and Spider-Man responded.
No injuries were reported.
